text:
Ivy: Tiny but mighty shoutout to @Raj for rescuing the tea cart this morning after it rolled into the stairs. Saved the snacks and my laptop charger. Legend move :tea: :shield:
Raj: haha it was dramatic but all safe! Pulled the cart back and held it steady while Ken unplugged everything. Teamwork :muscle:
Molly: saw the aftermath from the kitchen. Major kudos. Also appreciated the calm vibes while we cleared the area. :raised_hands:
Ken: no sparks, no drama. ops-bot pinged the facilities queue so someone will check the wheel locks later. :gear:
ops-bot: Incident recorded: TEACART-87. Facilities notified. Assigned to: FacilitiesTeam. :white_check_mark:
Ivy: also leaving a sticky note on the cart: "Handle with care, hero inside". small gestures = big smiles. anyone want to add a one-liner for the monthly kudos doc?
Molly: "Raj: tea cart heroism prevented soggy laptops and preserved morale." short and silly, fits well.
Raj: love it. If anyone wants to vote for a tiny reward, i'm neither picky nor proud. :grin:
Ken: :cookie: for heroics?
Ivy: :heart: on the cookie idea. Thanks again team. These micro-shoutouts keep the day bright.
